verdict.rationale: Plymouth Street's own materials cover O-1 in depth, including a startup-founder O-1 guide and F-1/J-1 to O-1 transition guides. They also compare O-1 with the EB-1 green-card path and claim a 'suite of visas and green card pathways' plus up-front visa design. Nothing in the evidence addresses H-1B, cap-exempt H-1B routes, E-2 or TN, so the full startup visa menu is not shown. Missing for 10: H-1B coverage including cap-exempt routes, E-2 guidance, TN guidance, broader green-card coverage beyond EB-1, a cross-visa decision guide for founders, independent corroboration.
